title: Add owner login with Principal ID and serial number management

requirements.summary: Implement owner/admin login system with access control for staff entry management operations
acceptanceCriteria: Owner can log in using Internet Identity authentication
Authenticated owner has permissions to add new entries
Authenticated owner can correct/edit existing entries
Authenticated owner can modify entry data
Unauthenticated users cannot access entry management features

file_operations.description: Add permission guards around staff management UI controls (add, edit, delete buttons) by using the authorization component's isCallerAdmin hook. Show read-only view for non-admin users. Use the authorization component to check admin permissions before rendering modification controls. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add visual indication of admin status in the user profile section of the sidebar. Display role badge (Admin/Owner) next to the username when the user has admin permissions. Use the authorization component's isCallerAdmin check to determine admin status. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure the useIsCallerAdmin hook properly wraps the backend isCallerAdmin query and returns the admin status for use in UI permission checks throughout the application.

requirements.summary: Display updated Serial Numbers in the staff management interface when Principal IDs are modified
acceptanceCriteria: Serial Number field shows the current value for each staff entry
When Principal ID is modified, Serial Number updates are visible immediately
Serial Number display is read-only and auto-generated

file_operations.description: Add Serial Number column to the staff table display showing Principal ID in a shortened, human-readable format (first 8 and last 4 characters with ellipsis). When editing a staff member's Principal ID via the edit dialog, display the updated Serial Number immediately after Principal ID change and before saving. Make Serial Number field read-only and auto-computed from the Principal ID. Add helper function to format Principal as Serial Number display string.
